gen-irish-grover-gf-basic: Chunky, friendly and a bit hand-shaped, Irish Grover makes every word look sturdy with its tall lowercase and softly swelling strokes. Basic stays quiet and tidy beneath it, a plain voice for the details.
gen-irish-grover-gf-cal-sans: Irish Grover has a playful, organic lean, with gently shaded curves that make each word look broad and sturdy. Cal Sans keeps one uniform stroke width and a tall x-height, so it carries the small text with a smooth, modern ease.
gen-irish-grover-gf-carlito: Tall, sturdy lowercase with open throats and a faint swell in every round letter gives Irish Grover its friendly weight. Carlito, a tighter sans-serif, handles the quieter text.
gen-irish-grover-gf-courier-prime: Irish Grover stands tall and sturdy, its lowercase big and its joins softly thinned. Beside Courier Prime's monospace precision, that organic playfulness feels loosened up, while the typewriter-like body keeps everything structured and orderly.
gen-irish-grover-gf-days-one: Big, friendly and a little pressed-glass round, that's Irish Grover up top. Days One follows with rope-ladder spacing and a tall x-height, so paragraphs would feel sturdy and approachable rather than fussy.
gen-irish-grover-gf-epunda-sans: Tall lowercase that makes words look sturdy and large is what sets Irish Grover apart, with soft, slightly lighter joins. Epunda Sans takes over for the text, its oversized open counters giving a sans-serif body plenty of daylight, while the heading earns its keep when big and short.
gen-irish-grover-gf-farro: Irish Grover has bowls that swell only slightly at their widest, which keeps its tall, organic letters friendly. But Farro, a plain sans with tube-like strokes and no contrast at all, is where the pair gets its strongest quality: a clear split between playful and plain.
gen-irish-grover-gf-fragment-mono: Playful and organic, Irish Grover leans on tall lowercase and softly shaded curves. Fragment Mono, a wire-like monospace laid out like nails on a ruler, is the one that does the precise, structured work, leaving the heading to supply the personality.
gen-irish-grover-gf-geist-mono: Soft, sturdy and tall, Irish Grover shades its round and straight strokes just enough to feel hand-made, then Geist Mono sets in as tubular, code-style monospace. A longer passage would read like a tidy, structured grid.
gen-irish-grover-gf-genos: Chunky and friendly, Irish Grover opens with tall, sturdy lowercase and softly shaded strokes. Genos, a tight sans-serif with a high midline, adds the pair's strongest quality: a playful heading sitting over a body that never snags.
